project.name: Smartlearners.ai CRM
project.description: Student engagement CRM with React/TypeScript frontend and FastAPI/Python backend with AI chatbot. Provides role-based dashboards (Teacher, School Admin, OrcaLex Admin) for monitoring student engagement, sending WhatsApp alerts, generating AI-powered MCQ challenges, and tracking activity feeds.

nodes.summary: React application entry point. Renders the App component inside React.StrictMode and attaches it to the DOM root element.

Root application component that sets up routing with react-router-dom. Defines ProtectedRoute for role-based access, DashboardLayout with navigation header and ChatBot, and AppRoutes mapping /teacher, /school, /orcalex paths to respective dashboards.

Central type definitions file. Defines enums (UserRole, EngagementStatus, NotificationType) and interfaces for all data models: User, School, StudentProfile, StudentEngagementSummary, EngagementAlert, dashboard data types, activity types, and MCQ challenge types.

Authentication context provider. Manages user state with localStorage persistence, provides login (creates mock user by role) and logout functions, and exposes isAuthenticated status via React context.
Dashboard data context provider. Shares dashboard data between components (e.g., between dashboard pages and the ChatBot) via React context.

API client layer using axios. Defines two axios instances (remote API at crmapi.smartlearners.ai and local at localhost:8000). Exports dashboardAPI, engagementAPI, alertAPI, activityAPI, challengeAPI, chatAPI, and healthAPI service objects mapping frontend calls to backend REST endpoints.

Login page component with role selector (Teacher, School Admin, OrcaLex Admin). Teachers enter username, School Admins enter school code, OrcaLex Admins login without credentials. Routes to appropriate dashboard after login.

Teacher dashboard page. Loads dashboard data by teacher username, displays MetricsCards, TeacherAnalytics charts, recent alerts, and a StudentTable with filtering by days since login. Supports sending alerts, challenges, viewing student details, and bulk alert operations.

School admin dashboard page. Loads school data by school code, displays MetricsCards, SchoolAnalytics, engagement overview with progress bars, platform health stats, and tabbed views for students/teachers/activity with day filtering and bulk alerts.

OrcaLex (platform) admin dashboard. Shows platform-wide metrics across all schools, AdminAnalytics charts with school leaderboard and donut charts, school summary table, and tabbed student/teacher/activity views with day filtering.
Floating AI chatbot component. Sends user messages to the backend chat API along with trimmed dashboard data context. Displays role-specific quick suggestions and adapts accent colors by user role.

Reusable student/teacher table component with engagement status badges, filter by status (all/at-risk/inactive), sort by name/lastLogin/sessions, checkbox selection for bulk operations, and action buttons (View, Alert, Challenge).
Dashboard metrics card grid component. Displays 5 metric cards (Total Students, Active Students, Active Sessions, At-Risk, Inactive) with animated SVG icons, accent colors, and hover effects.
Modal dialog for sending WhatsApp alerts to individual students. Displays student name, confirmation message, and handles the send operation with loading/error states.

Multi-step modal for creating and previewing AI-generated MCQ challenges. Step 1: select subject, topic, question count. Step 2: loading with skeleton. Step 3: preview questions with KaTeX math rendering, then send or regenerate.

Modal for viewing detailed student profile including engagement status, login stats, session counts, gap analysis scores table, and exam results table. Fetches data from the student-summary API endpoint.

Activity feed component displaying daily activity breakdowns in expandable day sections. Shows summary cards for practice, homework, exams, classwork counts. Supports filtering by role (student/teacher) and text search.

Pure SVG chart library with BarChart, GroupedBarChart, LineChart (with smooth Catmull-Rom curves), and DAUWAUMAUCards components. Features hover tooltips, animated bars/lines, and responsive SVG viewBox rendering.

Analytics section wrappers for each dashboard role. TeacherAnalytics shows status bars and engagement trend. SchoolAnalytics adds class-wise grouped bars and section engagement. AdminAnalytics adds school-wise donut charts and leaderboard table.
LaTeX math rendering component using KaTeX library. Parses text for inline ($...$) and display ($$...$$) math delimiters, renders to HTML with throwOnError:false for graceful fallback.

Global CSS file with Tailwind directives, base typography using Plus Jakarta Sans, custom scrollbar styling, glass-panel component class, and keyframe animations (gradient-shift, float, glow-pulse, dot-pulse, entrance-stagger).
Default Create React App CSS styles. Contains basic App layout classes (mostly unused in the current app which uses inline styles).

FastAPI application entry point. Configures CORS, registers all API routers (dashboard, engagement, challenge, activity, alert, intervention, chat), manages lifespan events for DB table creation and scheduler start/stop.
Environment configuration loader. Reads DATABASE_URL, INTERAKT_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, and AI_MODEL from .env file using dotenv.
SQLAlchemy database setup. Creates engine from DATABASE_URL, configures SessionLocal factory, defines Base for ORM models, and provides get_db dependency for FastAPI route injection.
Simple thread-safe in-memory TTL cache (30-minute default). Provides get, put, and invalidate operations for caching API responses to reduce database load.
APScheduler-based daily cron job for automated student interventions. Runs at 8:00 AM IST using PostgreSQL advisory locks to prevent duplicate execution across Gunicorn workers.

SQLAlchemy ORM model definitions mirroring existing Django database tables (read-only) plus CRM-owned tables. Defines School, Classes, Section, Student, Subject, GapAnalysis, Exam, StudentResult, SubjectTeacherMapping, OutstandingToken, BlacklistedToken, Homework, HomeworkSubmission, ClassworkSubmission, and InterventionLog.

Dashboard API router (/api/dashboard). Provides endpoints for teacher dashboard by username/school_id, school dashboard by code/id, OrcaLex admin dashboard aggregating all schools, and individual student summary with gap analysis and exam results.
Engagement API router (/api/engagement). Provides endpoints for detecting at-risk students by school or teacher, listing alerts, resolving alerts, and getting individual student engagement status.
Alert API router (/api/alerts). Provides endpoints for sending individual and bulk WhatsApp alerts to students by looking up phone numbers and calling the WhatsApp service.

Activity API router (/api/activity). Provides endpoints for school activity overview (daily breakdown), individual student activity timeline, and teacher activity timeline with configurable day ranges.

Challenge API router (/api/challenges). Provides endpoints for generating AI-powered MCQ preview questions via Gemini, sending manual/bulk challenges, listing student challenges, and marking challenges complete.
Chat API router (/api/chat). Single POST endpoint that receives natural-language messages with user role/context and delegates to the chat service for AI-powered CRM-aware responses.
Intervention API router (/api/interventions). Single endpoint to manually trigger the intervention check that sends alerts and challenges to inactive students.

Pydantic schemas for dashboard API responses. Defines TeacherDashboardData, SchoolDashboardData, OrcaLexSchoolSummary, and OrcaLexDashboardData models with engagement metrics and student/teacher lists.
Pydantic schemas for engagement data. Defines EngagementStatus enum, StudentEngagementSummary with login/session/status fields, and EngagementAlert model.
Pydantic schemas for activity tracking. Defines ActivityEntry, DailyActivitySummary, UserActivityTimeline, and ActivityOverview models for the activity feed system.
Pydantic schemas for the MCQ challenge system. Defines request/response models for sending, generating preview, and completing challenges with MCQQuestion and MCQOption models.

Core engagement calculation service. Computes student engagement status based on last_login days and session counts from JWT tokens. Provides functions for all student/teacher engagement queries, section-based teacher lookups, Google auth user handling, and alert generation.

AI chat service using Google Gemini. Classifies user intent via keyword matching, fetches relevant CRM data from internal API endpoints, then generates conversational responses using the Gemini model with dashboard context.
AI service for generating MCQ questions using Google Gemini. Handles JSON backslash escaping for LaTeX math expressions, implements retry logic, and parses AI-generated question content.
WhatsApp messaging service via Interakt API. Sends template-based WhatsApp messages to students using their phone numbers. Handles phone number normalization for Indian mobile numbers.
Activity tracking service. Queries GapAnalysis, HomeworkSubmission, Exam, ClassworkSubmission, and StudentResult tables to build student and teacher activity feeds with daily breakdowns.

Automated intervention service. Sends WhatsApp alerts and MCQ challenge notifications to students at day 3, 7, and 14 inactivity milestones. Tracks sent interventions to prevent duplicates and resets when students log back in.
Test Prep API client. Calls quizmode.smartlearners.ai to generate MCQ challenges for inactive students by resolving class/subject, fetching available chapters, and generating questions.
Centralized AI prompt templates. Contains MCQ system role instruction, JSON schema template, and requirements for generating CBSE/ICSE-aligned HOT questions with LaTeX math formatting rules.
Tailwind CSS configuration. Extends theme with custom brand/surface/ink color palettes, Plus Jakarta Sans and Source Serif 4 fonts, custom border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations.
TypeScript compiler configuration targeting ES5 with strict mode, ESNext modules, React JSX transform, and DOM/ESNext library support.

tour.title: Frontend Entry Point
tour.description: The React app starts here, rendering the App component into the DOM. This is the standard Create React App entry point.

tour.title: App Router & Layout
tour.description: The App component wraps everything in AuthProvider and DashboardProvider contexts, then defines routes: /login goes to LoginPage, and /teacher, /school, /orcalex go to role-specific dashboards wrapped in ProtectedRoute (auth check) and DashboardLayout (navigation + ChatBot).

tour.title: Authentication & Role Selection
tour.description: AuthContext manages user state with localStorage persistence. The login function creates a mock user with the selected role (Teacher, School Admin, OrcaLex Admin). Teachers provide a username, School Admins provide a school code. This role determines which dashboard and which API endpoints to call.

tour.title: Dashboard Page (Teacher Example)
tour.description: Each dashboard page loads data from the API on mount (e.g., getTeacherDashboardByUsername), then renders MetricsCards, AnalyticsSections charts, recent alerts, and a StudentTable. Users can send WhatsApp alerts, create AI MCQ challenges, and view student detail modals. The data is also shared via DashboardContext to the ChatBot.

tour.title: API Client Bridge
tour.description: The api.ts file bridges frontend and backend using two axios instances: one for the production API (crmapi.smartlearners.ai) and one for local development (localhost:8000). It exports typed API objects (dashboardAPI, engagementAPI, alertAPI, etc.) that map to backend REST endpoints.

tour.title: Backend Entry & Routing
tour.description: The FastAPI application registers 7 routers (dashboard, engagement, challenge, activity, alert, intervention, chat), configures CORS for localhost:3000, and manages the app lifecycle: creating CRM tables on startup and starting the daily intervention scheduler.

tour.title: Core Business Logic
tour.description: The engagement service is the heart of the CRM. It calculates each student's engagement status (Active/At-Risk/Low/Inactive) based on days since last login and JWT session counts. It queries the Django-mirrored Student, OutstandingToken, and GapAnalysis tables via SQLAlchemy to build StudentEngagementSummary objects used by all dashboards.

tour.title: Data Layer & Models
tour.description: SQLAlchemy ORM models mirror the existing Django PostgreSQL tables (Users_student, Users_school, myapp_gapanalysis, etc.) as read-only. The CRM also owns the crm_intervention_log table for tracking automated alerts. The database.py file manages the SQLAlchemy engine and session factory connected via DATABASE_URL from config.py.
